quests.title: Try a dessert neither of you has ordered before
quests.instructions: Pick it from a menu or bakery and share it.

quests.title: Colour or create for an hour
quests.instructions: Any colouring, drawing or craft, side by side or on a call.

quests.title: Take a photo with the same colour theme
quests.instructions: Agree on a colour and each take one photo where it stands out.

quests.title: Build a five-song shared playlist
quests.instructions: Each add songs until there are five you both like.

quests.title: Plan one date under AED 100
quests.instructions: Decide what, where and when. Doing it is a bonus.

quests.title: Finish one small Future Plans item together
quests.instructions: Pick something that takes under an hour.

quests.title: Send an unexpected voice note
quests.instructions: Something you'd normally only say in person.

quests.title: Recreate an old photograph
quests.instructions: Same pose, same place if you can.

quests.title: Watch a film the other person chose
quests.instructions: No vetoes once it's chosen.

quests.title: Have one phone-free meal
quests.instructions: Phones in another room until the plates are empty.

quests.title: Choose a place to visit one day
quests.instructions: Add it to your Bucket List with one reason each.

quests.title: Write one Open When letter
quests.instructions: Seal it in Togetherverse for the other person.

quests.title: Finish one Reveal Together round
quests.instructions: Answer, then reveal together.

quests.title: Make a shared mood board
quests.instructions: Start one in Our Creative Studio about anything you like.

quests.title: Cook or order from a cuisine new to you
quests.instructions: Rate it out of ten together.

quests.title: Add one memory to Our Universe
quests.instructions: With a photo if you have one.

quests.title: Go for a walk while on a call
quests.instructions: At least twenty minutes, describe what you see.

quests.title: Watch a sunrise or a sunset
quests.instructions: Together or at the same time in your two cities.

quests.title: Try a café neither of you has been to
quests.instructions: Order something you don't usually get.

quests.title: Leave a handwritten note
quests.instructions: Hide it somewhere the other person will find it, or send a photo of it.

quests.title: Teach each other a new word
quests.instructions: In any language, and use it in a sentence this week.

quests.title: Play a board or card game
quests.instructions: Best of three.

quests.title: Cook one full meal together
quests.instructions: Starter optional, dessert encouraged.

quests.title: Plant or repot something
quests.instructions: A herb on the windowsill counts.

quests.title: Read the same chapter
quests.instructions: Then talk about it for ten minutes.

quests.title: Swap three things you appreciated this month
quests.instructions: Say them out loud on a call or in person.

quests.title: Give a small gift under AED 30
quests.instructions: Something that made you think of them.

quests.title: Walk somewhere you've never walked
quests.instructions: A new street, park or beach.

quests.title: Visit a museum or gallery
quests.instructions: Or a virtual tour if you're apart.

quests.title: Share one photo every day for a week
quests.instructions: Of anything, no captions needed.

quests.title: Have breakfast together
quests.instructions: In person, or at the same time on a call.

quests.title: Design one room of your future home
quests.instructions: Pick colours, one piece of furniture and the lighting.

quests.title: Swap three childhood photos
quests.instructions: And the story behind each one.

quests.title: Try a free online class together
quests.instructions: Anything from drawing to a language.

quests.title: Give one specific compliment a day for a week
quests.instructions: Specific, not general.

quests.title: Have a picnic
quests.instructions: Even on the living-room floor.

quests.title: Dedicate a song and explain why
quests.instructions: One each.

quests.title: Sort out one drawer or shelf together
quests.instructions: With music on.

quests.title: Decide one wedding detail together
quests.instructions: Small or big, just decide it.

quests.title: Plan a weekend away
quests.instructions: Destination, where to stay and one thing to do.

quests.title: Drive or ride a route you've never taken
quests.instructions: No map until you get lost a little.

quests.title: Cook a dish from one of your families
quests.instructions: Ask for the recipe first.

quests.title: Bake something
quests.instructions: Cookies, a cake or bread.

quests.title: Play an online game on a call
quests.instructions: Word games and drawing games count.

quests.title: Find the moon at the same time
quests.instructions: Or the brightest star you can see.

quests.title: Write five memories on slips of paper
quests.instructions: Keep them for a future Memory Capsule.

quests.title: Do one good deed together
quests.instructions: Donate, help someone, or volunteer for an hour.

quests.title: Watch two films back to back
quests.instructions: One chosen by each.

quests.title: Try a sport neither of you plays
quests.instructions: Padel, bowling or table tennis.

quests.title: Have a calm evening at home
quests.instructions: Face masks, tea and an early night.

quests.title: Learn one piece of local history
quests.instructions: Visit a historic place or read about it together.

quests.title: Plan a full day out for AED 150
quests.instructions: Including food.

quests.title: Go on a photo walk
quests.instructions: Pick your best three photos afterwards.

quests.title: Write a short story one sentence at a time
quests.instructions: Take turns until it has an ending.

quests.title: Learn a recipe from a video
quests.instructions: Each make it in your own kitchen.

quests.title: Write a note to yourselves for next year
quests.instructions: Add it to a Memory Capsule.

quests.title: Dance to one full song in the kitchen
quests.instructions: No audience required.

quests.title: Taste three coffees or teas
quests.instructions: Pick a favourite together.

quests.title: Spend a morning with no plans
quests.instructions: Decide everything as you go.

quests.title: Draw each other
quests.instructions: Quickly, badly and with love.

quests.title: Pick one shared goal for next month
quests.instructions: Write it in Future Plans.

quests.title: Take an evening walk
quests.instructions: Somewhere quiet, at least half an hour.

quests.title: Show the other a favourite place
quests.instructions: In person, or by video.
